summary: Linear congruential pseudo-random number generator. Retrieves the TLS state block via TLSValueRetrievalWithInit, advances the state dword at TLS+20 through the MSVCRT LCG recurrence state = 214013 * state + 2531011, stores it back, and returns the high 15 bits of the new state (HIWORD(state) & 0x7FFF). The legacy ABI label identifies it as the CRT rand(). Called from dozens of sites across AI, audio, physics, particle, damage and random-selection code paths.

operations.description: Call TLSValueRetrievalWithInit to obtain the TLS state block base into v0.
Store the new state back into the dword at v0 + 20.
Return the high word of the new state masked to 15 bits: HIWORD(v1) & 0x7FFF.

unresolved: Structure of the TLS state block (only the state dword at +20 is touched here) is unknown.
Why the return uses HIWORD(state) & 0x7FFF rather than the classic (state / 65536) % 32768 spelling is a compiler artifact; both yield the same 15-bit value.
Owner object is not applicable; the function is a free __cdecl CRT-style routine.
